category_title: Students with SEBD who disengage due to perceived lack of opportunity in traditional settings
scenario_title: Disengagement during traditional whiteboard mathematics instruction
minimal_context: The student is in a traditional classroom setting copying trigonometry formulas from the whiteboard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the whiteboard. We are discussing trigonometry today. Copy these formulas down so we can use them to find heights.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gazes at the whiteboard and slowly starts copying) Okay.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's move on to the first example. Who can solve this on the board?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts pen down) Usually the same four students work everything out anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just pay attention to what they are doing and write it down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits completely still like a statue, just gazing at the whiteboard) I can't keep up with the rest of the class like this.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please look at the whiteboard. We are discussing trigonometry today. Copy these formulas down so we can use them to find heights.

STUDENT: (Gazes at the whiteboard and slowly starts copying) Okay.

TUTOR: Let's move on to the first example. Who can solve this on the board?

STUDENT: (Puts pen down) Usually the same four students work everything out anyway.

TUTOR: Just pay attention to what they are doing and write it down.

STUDENT: (Sits completely still like a statue, just gazing at the whiteboard) I can't keep up with the rest of the class like this.

context.environment: Traditional classroom setting, with access to outdoor school grounds
context.materials: Whiteboard, structures on school grounds for measuring heights
context.social_setting: Whole class instruction where 'the same four students work everything out'
context.time_context: During a mathematics lesson on trigonometry

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to learn by watching the teacher and copying from the whiteboard while a few peers dominate the participation
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Acts 'like statues', gazes at the whiteboard, fails to keep up with the rest of the class, does not participate
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feels a lack of opportunity to learn, unmotivated
related_quotes: copy all the time from the whiteboard and gaze at it
Usually the same four students work everything out.
Before, I could not keep up with the rest of the class.

behavior_patterns.condition: When instruction relies solely on passive observation (looking at the whiteboard)
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Gazes at the whiteboard without active involvement, acts 'like statues'
related_quotes: copy all the time from the whiteboard and gaze at it

behavior_patterns.condition: When other students quickly answer questions
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Withdraws from participation, allows others to do the work
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Feels they do not have the opportunity to learn
related_quotes: Usually the same four students work everything out. Here everyone has the opportunity. This motivates me.
